source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of design techniques (PDF 81).

blocks.text: Algorithm design ka matlab masail ko kaarkardagi aur asar se hal karne ke munazzam tareeqe banana hai. Mashhoor techniques divide and conquer, greedy algorithms, dynamic programming aur backtracking hain.

blocks.prompt: Algorithmic soch mein masle ko chhote hisson mein torne ki ahmiyat samjhaiye (short question 7).
blocks.explanation: Chhote hisse ek ek kar ke samajhna, hal karna aur jaanchna aasan hai; un ke hal mila kar (divide and conquer) ya dobara istemal kar ke (dynamic programming) kaam liya ja sakta hai; kaam baanta ja sakta hai; aur ghaltiyan dhoondna aasan hai. Yeh bare, uljhe masle ko qabil-e-intezam qadmon ke silsile mein badal deta hai.

items: Design techniques: divide and conquer, greedy, dynamic programming, backtracking.
